page.running_head: I. Ad Corinthios. Cap. I. / Verf.

main_text.p: 26 Videtis enim fratres vocationem vestram, quod non multi sapientes secundum carnem, non multi potentes, non multi nobiles.
27 Sed stulta mundi elegit deus ut pudefaceret sapientes, & infirma mundi elegit deus ut pudefaceret fortia
28 Et ignobilia mundi, & contemptibilia elegit Deus & non existentia ut existentia aboleret.
29 Ut non glorietur omnis caro coram Deo.
Qui tamen in Christo spiritualem & existentiam & sapientiam & gloriam habent.
30 Ex ipso autem vos estis in Christo Iesu, qui factus est nobis a Deo & iustitia, & sanctificatio & redemptio.
31 Ut sicut scriptum est, qui gloriatur, in domino glorietur. [illegible, ~6 letters]

page.notes: Lower part of the page is cut off; the text ends mid-page. Some words in the italic verse are damaged by show-through and may be misread, e.g. "pudefaceret", "existentia", "gloriam". Scan shows mostly blank paper with faint show-through and stains on the left; only the running head "Verf." is clearly legible. The narrow column at the far right edge shows only fragments of single letters (partly cut off), which cannot be read reliably, so they are not transcribed. No page number is visible.
